## [Shipping dates are Bait and Switch](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6866b9fb9f071a174a8bb788)
We have ordered several furniture pieces for a project, and almost everything has been delayed WAY beyond the originally promised date. A chair promised to be delivered in 8-10 weeks, now delayed by at least 13 weeks (past the 10 weeks originally promised). A coffee table promised to be "in stock" and delivered in 5-7 days, now delayed until October. There is no phone customer support, and if you are able to get someone on the Chat support, they just cut-and-paste the expected dates from the website - even when they are completely wrong. They seem to have nice stuff, but their customer service is a total joke.

July 2, 2025

Unprompted review

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 8, 2025

Hi Mike, thank you for your feedback, and we are so incredibly sorry to hear about your shopping experience with us. We sincerely apologize for the inconveniences caused by the delays in receiving the items that you ordered. We can see you corresponded with our Customer Experience team, and they provided updated ship dates. We hope that we will be able to make up for this next time around, but please let us know if there’s anything else we can help with. We appreciate your understanding and patience during this time.
